# Paul Frost

> Creative producer specializing in brand identity, cinematography, and product development. Based in Malmö, Sweden. Over a decade of experience across five continents.

## About

Paul Frost builds brands, tells their stories, and creates the films and products that make them real. His work spans brand identity design, documentary filmmaking, aerial cinematography, packaging design, full-stack development, and SEO-driven e-commerce. He has worked with clients including Canon, Dell, Business Insider, Dezeen, Patagonia, Triumph Motorcycles, and EIT Urban Mobility.

## Services

- Brand Identity & DNA
- Art Direction & Creative Direction
- Documentary & Narrative Filmmaking
- Cinematography & Color Grading
- Aerial Cinematography (Licensed Drone Operator, European regulations)
- Packaging Design
- Supply Chain & International Distribution
- Full Stack Web Development
- SEO Strategy & Content Systems
- E-Commerce & Organic Growth
- AI Automation & Generative AI

## Selected Work

- [Liberté Coffee](https://roamer.se/#work-liberte): Cold brew coffee brand built from idea to product in eight countries across four continents. Brand DNA, packaging, supply chain, and distribution.
- [EIT Urban Mobility](https://roamer.se/#work-eit): Multiple documentary and narrative films about urban planning and sustainable transport, shot across three countries.
- [Terralina](https://terralina.co): E-commerce brand built from zero audience to generating sales within the first month. SEO, AI automation, zero ad spend.
- [Fikola](https://fikola.com): Bilingual ride-sharing platform built from scratch as a solo developer. Backend, frontend, database, and deployment.
- [Business Insider Documentary](https://roamer.se/#work-business-insider): Documentary that reached eight million views. Research, interviews, cinematography across Norway and Nigeria.
- [You Cannot Hide](https://roamer.se/#work-you-cannot-hide): Cinematic portrait film of glass artist Manon Hillereau on Bornholm. Directed and produced.
- [Aerial Cinematography](https://roamer.se/#work-aerial): Licensed drone operations across Europe. Restricted airspace, permits, and cinematic filming.
